description: This file defines the BookingService class for managing booking history stored in local preferences in a Flutter app. It provides methods to load, add, and clear booking records, utilizing shared preferences for persistent storage, and operates on Booking model instances.

classes.name: BookingService
classes.description: Service class for handling booking history storage and retrieval using SharedPreferences.

methods.name: loadHistory
methods.description: Loads persisted booking history from local storage, returning a list of Booking objects sorted by creation date descending.

methods.name: addToHistory
methods.description: Adds a Booking object to the local storage history.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the booking history from local storage.
